Best rally-leader formations and hero choices

Bear Hunt damage is mainly driven by the rally leader's heroes and skills. Here is how to pick them and how generations matter.

Try formations in the simulator

Leader vs joiner

  • Leader: all skills of all 3 heroes apply (up to 9), plus hero stats and exclusive-gear rally bonuses.
  • Joiner: only the left hero's first skill, and only 4 selected slots.

Players with three strong attack heroes should lead; thin rosters are better off joining a strong leader.

What makes a good leader hero

The bear does not counterattack, so defense/HP skills are useless. Prioritize DMG-up, ATK-up, proc follow-up/DMG, troop-type buffs, and enemy DEF-down (Hendrik, Ligeia, Estrella, Eleanor: DEF -25% is a separate multiplier, counted as x1.25 on this site).

Generations

Newer heroes have higher base stats, but strong older heroes (e.g. Gen-1 Jeronimo/Natalia) with good skills and exclusive-gear rally bonuses are still core. Compare in the simulator.

Community-recommended rally leaders (by type)

Heroes valued for Bear Hunt rally leading as of 2026 in the overseas community, by troop type (general guidance — your own progression shifts the order).

🛡 Infantry
Jeronimo > Hector > Natalia > Flint > Magnus. Jeronimo carries multiple buffs (damage + attack + periodic damage + lethality) and stays top-priority despite being Gen 1. For F2P / light spenders (no Jeronimo or Natalia), Hector is the #1 infantry pick.
🗡 Lancer
Mia (with developed exclusive gear) > Dominic ≧ Ursar (Gen 16) ≧ Bertha (Gen 17) > Reina / Freya. Mia's "50%: enemy damage taken +50%" is a Bear-Hunt-grade debuff and keeps her on top in every generation once her gear is built; if it is not, prefer the newest lancer such as Dominic or Ursar. See the per-tier theoretical rankings on the generation pages.
🏹 Marksman
For marksman, "choose by exclusive-gear and hero skills, but the latest generation's base stats are simply good" — most say don't overthink it and use the newest available. As of October 2026 that is Gen 17's Eleanor (all-enemy DEF −25% plus marksman follow-ups; her gear gives rally lethality +15%), also the recommended Gen 17 marksman on strategy sites.

These rank "raw skill performance"; your own progression (level, exclusive gear, stars) easily reshuffles the order. Swap them in the simulator to see which raises your numbers most.

Skill types to avoid

Some skills are weak or wasted on a rally leader in Bear Hunt. Stun, stamina reduction, march speed, defense/HP buffs don't contribute to points against a bear that doesn't counterattack. The community is clear that "outside of damage/attack/lethality skills, value is low in Bear Hunt." Even some newest heroes whose skills reduce enemy damage dealt aren't useful here, lowering their rally-leader value.
